differences.note: decided by the project lead (step 5, run 41423202796): noted; the extra block is unexplained. Per-unit facts of the converter (20 units): units 0, 2, 3 and 4 give no output, unit 1 (45 bytes at 42) is accepted and units 5 to 9 are refused ('bada'); units 10 to 19 are accepted; 11 accepted units give 11 outputs of 1,024 = 11,264. FDK refuses units 0 to 9 (ten samples outside every mdat) and decodes 10 to 19 (10,240). The converter holds frames back, so an output cannot be tied to a unit; that unit 1 decodes in Core Audio and is refused by FDK is a reading of the counts, not shown.
